metadata.task: Track 2, Step 3.3: Full-Architecture DeBERTa-v3-small CPU Feasibility Pilot
metadata.auditor: Senior ML Infrastructure Engineer and Experimental Auditor

1_actual_pretrained_model_loading.details: DebertaV2ForSequenceClassification (141.9M params) loaded offline in 0.34s; 100% weights intact.

2_real_tokenizer_and_dataset_input.details: DebertaV2Tokenizer loaded offline (vocab 128,001); real text inputs from sft_v2/binary/train.jsonl tokenized.

3_forward_pass.details: Average forward latency 177.5ms; clean logits [-0.0122 to 0.1285] and CrossEntropyLoss [0.5788 to 0.8187].

4_backward_pass.details: Average backward latency 286.3ms; full reverse-mode autograd computed through all 12 transformer layers.

5_optimizer_step.details: AdamW stepped across 141.9M parameters; verified non-zero parameter delta (0.00033 to 0.00073).

6_gradient_integrity.details: All gradients strictly finite (no NaN, no Inf); non-zero gradients across 106 of 106 trainable tensors; L2 norm 8.92 to 11.54.

7_peak_memory_and_swap_safety.details: Peak RSS 2,370 MB (~2.31 GB); Available physical RAM maintained > 4,597 MB (4.5 GB safety buffer, far above 700 MB abort limit); Swap drift +200 MB.

8_cpu_throughput.details: Overall: 0.71 samples/sec (2,552 samples/hr); Steady-state: 0.87 samples/sec (3,130 samples/hr) on 4 CPU threads.

9_binary_objective_readiness.details: Feasible for bounded CPU training/pilot, but full 26,054 training set takes ~8.3 to 10.2 hours per epoch on CPU; GPU recommended for multi-epoch training.

10_nli_objective_readiness.details: Requires separate 3-class classification head (num_labels=3), longer premise-hypothesis context, and dedicated pilot.

11_span_objective_readiness.details: Requires token-level classification architecture (DebertaV2ForTokenClassification) and resolution of character-to-subword alignment gap.
